title: HsStore v1.3: iOS Cupertino Edition Rolled Out
subtitle: Immersive Apple design language, lightning-fast pull-to-refresh, and ambient particle controls.
author: HsStore Architecture
content: Welcome to the all-new HsStore experience. Built completely around authentic Apple iOS design principles, the new interface features clean Cupertino segmented controls, translucent frosted navigation bars, and instant pull-to-refresh. You can now toggle background particle effects anytime to optimize battery life.
bulletPoints: Authentic iOS App Store layout with dedicated Today news feed and Apps directory
Full Pull-To-Refresh on Today, Apps, and Downloads queues
Instant Master Particle Switch in header and settings
Independent remote News JSON controller via Pastebin (CTpQXLcc)
Embedded crash telemetry and feedback directly in Settings

title: Security Bulletin: SHA-256 Package Integrity Shield
subtitle: Automated cryptographic sandbox verification across all community mod packages.
author: Security Audit Squad
content: Security is the foundation of HsStore. Every APK submission is automatically disassembled, decompiled, and analyzed against malicious heuristics. The SHA-256 cryptographic checksum is published openly on every download card so power users can verify cryptographic integrity before installation.
bulletPoints: 100% automated DEX inspection for undeclared trackers
Real-time download verification checksum against tampering
Zero-permission storage compliance with Android 14+ Photo Picker
Sandbox execution auditing prior to public listing

title: Custom Themes: Neon Cyan, Toxic Emerald & Apple Indigo
subtitle: Fine-tune your workspace with dynamic OLED black appearances and custom accent palettes.
author: Design Guild
content: Make HsStore truly yours. Switch between midnight OLED black and crisp light modes, choose from four hand-crafted Apple accent presets (Classic Blue, Indigo Pro, Purple Neon, Mint Green), and customize background particle velocity.
bulletPoints: Midnight OLED theme reduces battery drain on AMOLED displays
Apple SF-inspired typography and translucent glass materials
Subtle, Medium, or Dense ambient particle physics engine

title: HsStore v1.3 Patch Notes & Changelog
subtitle: Performance improvements, network resilience, and dual remote JSON sync.
author: Release Engineering
content: Here is what changed in this version. We updated our network engine with dual Retrofit services to separate the app catalogue from community announcements, enabling rapid push updates without touching the package index.
bulletPoints: Separate Pastebin controllers for Apps (GEZX8zve) and News (CTpQXLcc)
Adaptive fallback when Pastebin contains raw placeholder text
Offline disk caching prevents cold-start delays
